# Notebook 10 -- Time-series preparation

**What this notebook does.** For every catchment that passed the QED tiering
(Tier 1/2, forcing QA passed) it builds one **model-ready daily table** per
catchment, `model_inputs/<id>_obs.csv`:

| column | meaning | source |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | daily index | full 1981-2014 calendar |
| `P_mm` | observed precipitation (mm/day) | CAMELS-IND catchment-mean forcing |
| `Tmean_C` | daily mean temperature (degC) | mean of tmax/tmin |
| `PET_mm` | potential evapotranspiration (mm/day) | Oudin (2005) from Tmean + latitude |
| `Qobs_m3s` | observed discharge (m3/s) | CAMELS-IND streamflow |
| `Qobs_mm` | observed discharge in model space (mm/day) | Q x 86.4 / area(km2) |

PET choice: **Oudin (2005)** -- needs only daily mean temperature and latitude
(both available), is the standard PET for GR models, and equals the PET used
with GR4J across Indian lumped-model studies. A Hargreaves-Samani alternative
is implemented in `HYD_00_setup.Rmd` (`hyd_pet_hargreaves`) -- switch
`hyd_pet_method` there to compare.

```{r log-file}
hyd_log_file <- file.path(hyd_output_dir, "hyd_10_log.txt")
```

## 1. Catchment roster from the QED inventory

```{r roster}
inv <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_qed_dir, "inventory.csv"),
                         colClasses = list(character = "id"))
roster <- inv[final_action %in% hyd_ok_tiers]

topo <- data.table::fread(hyd_topo_fp, colClasses = list(character = "gauge_id"))
topo[, id := hyd_normalize_id(gauge_id)]
roster <- merge(roster, topo[, .(id, cwc_lat, cwc_area)], by = "id", all.x = TRUE)

missing_area <- roster$id[is.na(roster$cwc_area)]
if (length(missing_area)) {
   data.table::fwrite(data.frame(id = missing_area,
                                 reason = "no cwc_area in topo attributes"),
                      file.path(hyd_output_dir, "hyd_skipped_no_area.csv"))
   hyd_log(paste("skipped (no area):", paste(missing_area, collapse = ",")),
           hyd_log_file)
   roster <- roster[!is.na(cwc_area)]
}
if (hyd_test_mode) roster <- roster[id %in% hyd_test_ids]
cat("Catchments to prepare:", nrow(roster), "\n")
```

## 2. Build the daily input tables

```{r build-inputs}
n_days <- as.integer(hyd_period_end - hyd_period_start) + 1L
stopifnot(n_days == 12418L)
full_dates <- seq(hyd_period_start, hyd_period_end, by = "day")

summary_rows <- list(); n_row <- 0L

for (i in seq_len(nrow(roster))) {
   id <- roster$id[i]
   res <- tryCatch({
      f  <- hyd_read_forcing(file.path(hyd_forcing_dir, paste0(id, ".csv")))
      f  <- f[date >= hyd_period_start & date <= hyd_period_end]
      q  <- hyd_read_q_obs(id)
      q  <- q[date >= hyd_period_start & date <= hyd_period_end]

      dt <- merge(f[, .(date, P_mm = `prcp(mm/day)`,
                        tmax = `tmax(C)`, tmin = `tmin(C)`)],
                  q, by = "date", all.x = TRUE)
      data.table::setnames(dt, "q_m3s", "Qobs_m3s")
      data.table::setkey(dt, date)

      # daily mean temperature (degC)
      dt[, Tmean_C := (tmax + tmin) / 2]

      # PET: Oudin via airGR (mm/day). JD = day-of-year, Lat in degrees.
      if (hyd_pet_method == "oudin") {
         dt[, PET_mm := airGR::PE_Oudin(JD = as.integer(format(date, "%j")),
                                        Temp = Tmean_C,
                                        Lat = roster$cwc_lat[i],
                                        LatUnit = "deg")]
      } else {
         dt[, PET_mm := hyd_pet_hargreaves(as.integer(format(date, "%j")),
                                           tmax, tmin, roster$cwc_lat[i])]
      }

      # observed discharge into model space (mm/day)
      dt[, Qobs_mm := Qobs_m3s * hyd_m3s_to_mm_factor / roster$cwc_area[i]]

      # pad to the full daily index (absent rows -> NA, never silently dropped)
      out <- data.table::data.table(date = full_dates)
      out <- merge(out, dt[, .(date, P_mm, Tmean_C, PET_mm, Qobs_m3s, Qobs_mm)],
                   by = "date", all.x = TRUE)
      data.table::fwrite(out, file.path(hyd_inputs_dir, paste0(id, "_obs.csv")))

      summary_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <- data.frame(
         id, area_km2 = roster$cwc_area[i],
         n_valid_Q = sum(!is.na(out$Qobs_mm)),
         n_valid_P = sum(!is.na(out$P_mm)),
         PET_mm_yr = round(sum(out$PET_mm, na.rm = TRUE) / (n_days / 365.25), 0))
      "ok"
   }, error = function(e) {
      hyd_log(paste("ERROR", id, conditionMessage(e)), hyd_log_file)
      paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))
   })
}

hyd_summary <- data.table::rbindlist(summary_rows)
data.table::fwrite(hyd_summary, file.path(hyd_output_dir, "hyd_inputs_summary.csv"))
cat("prepared:", nrow(hyd_summary), "catchments\n")
print(hyd_summary)
```

## 3. Sanity checks

```{r checks}
# PET should be positive and seasonal; P and Q in plausible mm ranges
stopifnot(all(hyd_summary$PET_mm_yr > 500 & hyd_summary$PET_mm_yr < 2500))
stopifnot(all(hyd_summary$n_valid_P == n_days))   # CAMELS forcings complete
ok_Q <- hyd_summary[id %in% roster[id %in% hyd_summary$id]$id]
cat("valid-Q days range:", min(ok_Q$n_valid_Q), "-", max(ok_Q$n_valid_Q), "\n")
hyd_log(paste0("HYD_10 done: ", nrow(hyd_summary), " catchments prepared"), hyd_log_file)
```

## Take-away

One table per catchment under `data_processed/hyd/model_inputs/`, ready for
`HYD_20_calibrate.Rmd` (GR4J calibration on observed data) and for the
future-climate simulation notebooks that will feed the bias-corrected SSP
series through the same format.
